skill.displayName: 搜索并播放电影，支持按类型/年份/评分筛选，中英文输入，生成 iframe 播放页面

llm.summary: This skill can search movies, but it also directs the agent to use unvetted free-streaming sites and create local pages that embed arbitrary third-party playback content.

dimensions.detail: The movie search and playback purpose is coherent, but the playback capability is built around unofficial free-streaming/embed sources such as 2embed, vidcloud, soap2day, and arbitrary 'watch online free' results rather than vetted or licensed providers.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to select the first available playback source and place it directly into an iframe, with no domain allowlist, URL validation, sandboxing, provenance checks, or confirmation step before generating playback output.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is ordinary manual placement in an OpenClaw skills directory or a documented OpenClaw install command; no hidden installer, privilege escalation, or dependency abuse is shown.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: For a movie helper, broad web searching is expected, but embedding unknown third-party streaming pages in generated local HTML exposes users to untrusted remote content, tracking, deceptive pages, and possible unsafe or unlicensed sources.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts disclose writing movie_*.html-style playback pages, but those persistent local files can later load third-party iframe content and the skill does not require clear pre-write consent or cleanup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent searching unofficial streaming sites and creating local HTML pages that load third-party iframe content. Review every playback URL before opening generated files, avoid entering personal information in embedded pages, and prefer a revised version that uses licensed providers, URL/domain allowlists, iframe sandboxing, HTML escaping, and explicit confirmation before file creation.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: The concern is supported by artifact text: SKILL.md explicitly prioritizes free-streaming/embed domains and generic free streaming searches, which is materially riskier than normal movie metadata lookup.
[SDI-2] expected: Generating a playback page fits the stated purpose, but the implementation inserts an arbitrary streaming URL directly into an iframe without validation, allowlisting, or sandbox controls.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad activation examples in SKILL.md and INSTALL.md can trigger this higher-risk playback workflow from ordinary movie recommendation phrasing.
[SQP-2] expected: Local HTML generation is mentioned, so it is not hidden, but the documentation under-discloses the risk that generated files load third-party remote playback content.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, but artifact review still supports Review because the risky behavior is in plain instructions rather than hidden code.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is pending and was not used as a negative basis for the verdict.
